# Provider attribution and reuse review

Reviewed 8 November 2026. This private academic experiment does not relicense
provider data. Source observations are unchanged; our loader creates explicitly
labelled 100 × monthly log changes for the price series. Downloads are the
7 November 2026 source repository snapshot, not new provider downloads.

| Files | Attribution and reuse source |
|---|---|
| MCOILBRENTEU.csv | Source: US Energy Information Administration, via FRED, November 2026 snapshot. [EIA reuse policy](https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php) permits distribution of its data; acknowledge source/date. |
| PNGASEUUSDM.csv, PCOALAUUSDM.csv, PCOPPUSDM.csv; the ten M7 commodity CSVs PMAIZMTUSDM through PRAWMINDEXM | Source: International Monetary Fund, Primary Commodity Prices, via FRED (individual links in manifest). [IMF statistical-data terms](https://www.imf.org/en/About/copyright-and-terms.) permit distribution with accurate attribution and identification of transformations. Retain and communicate those conditions; commercial reuse requires permission. |
| WB_FOOD.csv | Source: World Bank, Pink Sheet Food index. [World Bank data terms](https://data.worldbank.org/summary-terms-of-use): CC BY 4.0 subject to dataset-specific exceptions and additional terms. |
| GPR.csv | Source: Dario Caldara and Matteo Iacoviello, Measuring Geopolitical Risk (2022), downloaded 7 November 2026. [Provider page](https://www.matteoiacoviello.com/gpr.htm) explicitly permits redistribution under CC BY with author/source credit. |
| GSCPI.csv | Source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Global Supply Chain Pressure Index. © 2026 Federal Reserve Bank of New York. [Terms](https://www.newyorkfed.org/privacy/termsofuse.html) permit copying/distribution with attribution, unchanged permissions and clearly identified modifications. No endorsement is implied. [Data](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/policy/gscpi). |
| INDU_006.csv, RETA_006.csv, CONS_006.csv | Source: European Commission, DG ECFIN, Business and Consumer Surveys. [Commission reuse policy](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/rules-reuse-commission-information): CC BY 4.0 default for Commission-owned content, subject to individual exceptions. Source keys and URLs retained in manifest. |
| FOODPR.csv, FOODUN.csv, IGDSX.csv | Source: ECB statistics, HICP. [ESCB reuse policy](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/ecb_statistics/governance_and_quality_framework/html/usage_policy.en.html) permits reuse with source citation and unchanged statistics/metadata. Original observations and metadata preserved; transformed forecasts are our calculations. |
| EUEPUINDXM.csv | Source: Scott Baker, Nicholas Bloom and Steven Davis, European Economic Policy Uncertainty index, via FRED. [European index provider page](https://www.policyuncertainty.com/europe_monthly.html) explicitly licenses the work under CC BY 4.0. Retain author/source credit and license link. |

All 24 requested series are present. No provider restriction preventing this
noncommercial academic redistribution was identified in the linked conditions.
Keep source attribution, license links and transformation notices with the data;
this is not a blanket license for unrelated provider content or commercial reuse.
